pictures.name: MA1-Frontier-Camp
pictures.prompt: Roman army camp at night on the frozen bank of the Danube, around 170 AD: rows of leather tents, a few campfires, soldiers in red cloaks and bronze helmets keeping watch, snow on the ground, a wide dark river and forest beyond. One large command tent glows from inside. Deep blue night, warm gold firelight. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.

Rich textiles, warm lamplight, deep blue shadows. Writing shown as faint marks, no readable letters.
